Frontegg — authentication

frontegg/auth · version 1

envs add frontegg/auth

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
FRONTEGG_BASE_URL required config Workspace address the browser SDK points at.. Shape ^https://\S+$. where to get it
FRONTEGG_CLIENT_ID required config Client id, carried by the same browser flow.. where to get it
FRONTEGG_API_KEY required secret Server-side key.. where to get it
